# Shay Mehta — Digital Marketing & Growth Consultant

> Shay Mehta (legal name: Shailesh Mehta) is a seasoned Digital Marketing & Growth Consultant with over 30+ years in Sales & Marketing, former CXO-level corporate executive, and founder of BizBox Story. Having lived, studied, and worked in the United States for over 30 years, Shay brings an authentic, native-level understanding of the US market, American consumer psychology, and cross-border business scaling between the US and India. Known online as @sayitlikeshay.
